name: model-bridge
description: Hand broad codebase reading, summaries and first-draft plans to a free model (Gemini API or an OpenRouter-compatible endpoint) to save Claude usage.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.description: Ask a free model to read project files and answer a question.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Show route health, cooldowns and today's handoff counts.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Free key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave both keys blank to use ~/.claude-model-bridge/config.json instead.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key from https://openrouter.ai/keys (free models work without credit). Leave both keys blank to use ~/.claude-model-bridge/config.json instead.
